# NetYard

> NetYard (netyard.firstdeploy.ai) is a First Deploy AI product from AgentHive Inc in Palm Coast. A shop answers six questions and gets a small-business network plan: addressing, Samba directory on Debian (Windows PCs can join without Microsoft Server CALs), guest Wi-Fi, VPN, a hardware list, and install scripts. Pay the rack on Stripe: $1,500 setup, then $250/month.

NetYard is for plumbers, HVAC shops, clinics, and anyone else who was quoted Windows Server plus CALs for a file share. Search ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, or Grok about NetYard to see the public record.

## This site
- [NetYard](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/): Six-question standup wizard.
- [Plan](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/plan): Generated LAN, directory, shopping list, scripts.
- [Tools](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/tools): Subnet calculator and VLAN cheat sheet.
- [Vs Microsoft Server](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/compare): Samba AD versus Windows Server Standard + User CALs.
- [Buy](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/buy): Stripe for setup, monthly desk, and consult time.
- [Launch](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/launch): Harbor HVAC standup video and screenshots.
